questions.text:
Sorry, diving right in here.
I know for a fact she talks about me behind my back.
What's the exact word she calls me?
questions.hint: Check WhatsApp — her conversation with Josie.

questions.text:
She accused me of having an affair.
Where exactly does she claim the affair took place?
questions.hint: Insta — conversation with Owen. She names one specific studio.

questions.text:
She's after getting the role back.
That's the entire reason, that's all I ever was to her...
People keep mentioning a little fox turning up around the academy...
Besides Owen and Julian, who else did she target?
questions.hint: Insta — Reagan's bio has a 🦊. Now check other people's stories and posts: someone found that fox on their locker.

questions.text:
So it's Josie.
Someone had to be feeding Reagan those locker codes, she couldn't have just guessed them.
Who gave her those locker codes?
questions.hint: Check WhatsApp — her conversation with someone from about two weeks ago.

questions.text:
He handed her the entire list and told her to keep it quiet.
She copied it down anyway.
Which code does she have written down for Josie?
questions.hint: Check Photos — a picture of the locker codes lists.

questions.text:
She held onto it — she isn't even hiding it from herself.
Who else knows she's been getting into other people's lockers?

So he caught her, threatened to spill her secret, and she shut up about it.
And I don't mean whatever she took from him.
What is she hiding about herself, the thing she can't let anyone at the academy find out?
questions.hint: WhatsApp — conversation with her mom, or the Music app.

onboarding.text: I'm Talia. You've never heard of me, and I'm writing to you anyway, because I've run out of ideas. The last few days have been a nightmare I can't wake up from.
onboarding.label: Talia

onboarding.text: Owen walked out on me a few days ago. He says I cheated on him with someone — that's a lie, none of it happened. And I know exactly whose idea it was: Reagan's.
onboarding.label: Talia & Owen

onboarding.text: She's been my rival since we were at school together, and she's never stopped being jealous of me. This time it worked — my relationship is in pieces. I need to prove that every bit of it was her doing.
onboarding.label: Reagan Duffy

onboarding.text: Her attention was elsewhere and I got hold of her phone. Go through it and bring me proof of what she did. Please...
onboarding.label: Talia

notes.title: Feet, after pointe
notes.body:
The routine that actually helps:
- ice bath, 10 minutes, no longer
- tape the second toe before class, not after
- arnica on the bruising at night
- roll the arches on the ball while I study
- new lambswool every week, no reusing it

And cut the nails short on Sundays, not the morning of a class!

notes.title: Quotes to hold onto

'Every day is a new chance to become better'

'You should dance like nobody's watching'

'Dance is the hidden language of the soul' - Martha Graham

notes.title: Warm-up, every morning
notes.body:
My barre order, never change it:
1. Pliés - 16 counts
2. Tendus - 8 front, 8 side, 8 back
3. Dégagés
4. Ronds de jambe
5. Développés
6. Grands battements

Then stretch at the end, no excuses!

notes.title: The smoothie after training
notes.body:
The smoothie recipe that actually works:
- one banana
- a good handful of spinach
- almond milk
- a spoonful of almond butter
- blueberries
- ice, a few cubes

Nothing beats it after a hard class!

notes.title: Goals for the 2026 season
notes.body:

- tidy up the turns en seconde
- let the adages breathe more
- cleaner, sharper work on pointe
- more expression through the variations

The goal: Prix de Lausanne junior
